pck_android_mb.note: resources exported with the Android preset (bulk of the AAB). N-30 bis: AAB = pck + ~11 MB (engine, plugins), so pck fail 58 keeps the AAB under the 70 MB budget; measured 33.1 MB on 2026-11-05

apk_mb.note: debug/release APK when the game-android artifact exists

startup_headless_s.note: median of 5: engine init + autoloads + boot scene + 5 frames, CI runner

lock_scene_headless_s.note: median of 3: plan B lock scene + 5 frames

startup_rss_mb.note: peak RSS of the headless boot (no GPU); proxy for leaks/oversized resources
